receipt.public_excerpt: PERSONA-prompted models performed better than NO-PERSONA witnesses overall

evidence_items.explanation: The randomized comparison reports GPT-4.5 identification rates of 73% with the persona and 36% without it, with persona performance above chance in both populations. However, no-persona performance was not significantly below chance in the Prolific population, which limits any absolute claim of necessity.

unresolved_gaps: The experiment does not establish that this particular persona was necessary among all possible prompts.
The two participant populations provide replication within the same research project; the accessible evidence reviewed does not establish an independent replication of the exact prompt comparison.
